reviews.text:
We rely on your clinic for monthly checkups and annual vaccinations and examinations for our elderly dog ​​with a heart condition.

We feel at ease bringing our dog in every day because you respond immediately in emergencies.

You patiently explain things we don't understand, which is very educational.

The clinic is clean and has a warm atmosphere, and we are incredibly grateful to the two trustworthy doctors and the always-friendly staff.

We also greatly appreciate that you are open on weekends.

We look forward to continuing to rely on your services.

We've been taking our puppy to puppy classes once a week since he was about two and a half months old.

Since he can't go for walks yet, he doesn't have many opportunities to interact with other dogs. However, here, the dogs can play freely and naturally develop social skills, so I feel it's a very good environment.

Our puppy is always smiling and happy when he comes here, and he's always more energetic and playful than anyone else. Seeing him like that is one of my joys.

Also, being able to easily consult with the trainer about any problems or concerns we have in our daily lives is very reassuring and helpful.

We hope to continue receiving their services even after he grows up and graduates from puppy classes.

The certificate preparation was sloppy and the person in charge lacked sufficient knowledge. Furthermore, they couldn't even properly stamp it.

This raises concerns about the quality of the actual medical care provided.

During our morning walk, my dog ​​suddenly started limping and holding his front paw, which worried me, so I brought him in for his first visit. By the time we arrived, he wasn't limping as much, but when I explained that I was worried, the vet kindly replied, "It's alright, I'm glad everything's okay," which was very reassuring.

I had been looking for a reliable clinic in addition to our regular vet for emergencies, so I would definitely like to visit again if anything comes up.

Thank you very much!

I've been going to this clinic for about five years since I brought my dog ​​home, and I think the vet is very thorough and caring. They also collaborate with specialists for allergies, you can book appointments via LINE, and they offer puppy classes, which are great for socializing your new puppy.

I have a 2-year-5-month-old female French bulldog. I've been taking care of her since she was born. She had an elongated soft palate, so I was recommended surgery to remove it, which I had done last October. I was worried, but after three months, her quality of life has improved dramatically. She now loves walks and the dog park. This breed is prone to illnesses, so I'm grateful for all the time-saving advice you provide. My dog ​​runs whenever I'm near the hospital.

I started keeping a dog when Abyss Animal Hospital opened, and I've been taking care of them ever since. The examinations and explanations are always thorough and easy to understand, so I feel at ease. The clinic is clean and the staff are kind, which I appreciate. I also ask them to trim my dog, and I'm grateful that they always make him look so cute. I look forward to continuing to do business with you.

My pug was diagnosed with encephalitis and was in life-threatening condition, but this hospital responded very quickly. I was filled with anxiety because I had heard it was a disease with a high mortality rate, but thanks to the appropriate treatment, he miraculously recovered and even achieved remission. I am truly grateful.

Every check-up is thorough, and when I ask questions about anything I'm concerned about, they explain everything clearly and in detail, which greatly eases my anxiety. They listen carefully to what I have to say, so I feel comfortable discussing things with them.

They are also very gentle with dogs, and I believe this is a hospital where you can confidently entrust your beloved family member.

My 14-year-old dachshund is being treated by this vet.

I'm very grateful for how thoroughly and accurately everyone explains things. The ability to schedule appointments in 15-minute increments makes it much easier to plan my schedule. 😊

We've been taking our French Bulldog to this clinic for seven years, since he was a puppy. He's prone to illness, but they always provide accurate examinations, diagnoses, and treatments, giving us peace of mind.

We also have him shampooed every month, and they provide care tailored to his skin condition, so he rarely has skin problems.

The doctor and staff are always smiling and helpful, and they also offer advice on daily care. This clinic truly shows their love for animals. We look forward to continuing our relationship with them.
